plugins.name: shipyard
plugins.description: Seventeen skills for taking a consumer app from idea to store listing on an Expo + Next.js monorepo — research-first discovery, Clerk auth, Postgres/Supabase with RLS, premium UI that avoids AI slop, onboarding and paywall conversion, RevenueCat/Stripe/Paystack, push, localisation, ASO, observability, performance, cost control, store submission, an adversarial self-review loop, and visual verification that drives the running app on simulator, emulator or browser to prove what rendered.
